ops.body:
Push split now (Recommended)
Question: The Intel split for PR438 shard 0 is frozen and unpushed (runner-split.diff d4f73c42, one line, actionlint clean, nothing else changed). Inspection found one architecture gap: cryptography 49.0.0 and lazy-object-proxy 1.12.0 have only arm64 macOS wheels in uv.lock, so the macos-15-intel shard would build both from sdist (Rust+OpenSSL, clang). Tests are not skipped and the product is unchanged, but the shard runs on source-built copies and may cost minutes or go red on a toolchain gap. Pushing cancels the queued ARM attempt 2. Push it?
Options: Push split now (Recommended) | Hold, wait for ARM | Push split + note risk
